signal: Each signal scores 1 to 4 on its written rule.
factor: A factor is the weighted average of its signals.
project: Factors are weighted into two halves (what we control, what we do not control). The project score is the average of the two halves; the person can choose the higher of the two instead.

red_flags.rule: A red-flag signal at its worst case rates the project at least 3 (score floor 2.5).

stake: What is at stake is read beside the score and sets the priority; it is not averaged in.

priority.Act now: High risk and a lot at stake
priority.Watch: A lot at stake and close to the line

direction: Rose or fell = the score moved by more than 0.08 in 90 days.
version_rule: The dashboard gets a new version only when the scoring changes. A morning check refreshes the same version.
